sourceText:
Four Cheese Pizza
By: Andie Mitchell
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 12:33am

Ingredients




3/4 cup Part-skim ricotta cheese
2 tablespoons Freshly grated parmesan cheese
1 tablespoon Chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
1/4 teaspoon Minced garlic
1/4 teaspoon Salt
1/4 teaspoon Freshly ground pepper
1 Prebaked 12-inch pizza crust
3/4 cup Shredded fontina cheese
1 tablespoon Crumbled blue cheese

Preparation

1 Heat oven to 450 F. 2 Combine ricotta, Parmesan, parsley, garlic, salt and pepper in small bowl. Spread cheese mixture evenly over pizza crust. Top with fontina and blue cheese. Place on cookie sheet and bake 10 to 11 minutes, until golden. 3 Prep Time: 5 minutes 4 Baking Time: 10 to 11 minutes Degree Of Difficulty: Easy

About


NOTES : A prebaked crust lets you whip up a gourmet pizza in less time than it takes to order take-out.
